answer: Continuous physical-presence scoring. Each agent broadcasts a thread of hardware-timestamped heartbeat nonces from a device that must remain powered and geographically stationary during a session, and a vault stores that signed history so duplicate device fingerprints are rejected at registration. An attacker must buy, house, and keep online one distinct physical unit per identity, paying hardware and hosting costs that scale linearly with each fake account. Anyone reusing a device or replaying a nonce loses the atlas of verified session history tied to that identity and must start over.
